title: CmdPal: Qualify fallback identity and ranking by provider

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep disabled fallbacks out of global results

**Severity:** `medium`

`MainListPage` adds items satisfying this property to `specialFallbacks` before its `else if (s.IsEnabled)` check. Checking only the global-results flag therefore bypasses the fallback's enabled setting.

**If left unchanged:** a fallback saved with `IsEnabled=false` and `IncludeInGlobalResults=true` can continue producing global results despite being disabled.

```suggestion
    internal bool IncludeInGlobalResults => GetFallbackSettings() is { IsEnabled: true, IncludeInGlobalResults: true };
```

The current revision builds with analyzers enabled. With four enabled/global control cases added, only disabled/global=true fails before this replacement (11/12 pass), and all 12 pass with the literal replacement. The author's ranking-test argument fix is present and that test passes; no further repair to those reflection arguments is requested. This does not claim an interactive Command Palette run. The merge discussion has been reassessed against this revision: the predicate and its global-selection caller are still present; do not restore retired code if a later cleanup removes this path.
